snippet.title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds is Coming to XBOX Game Pass!
snippet.description:
RuneScape: Dragonwilds is coming to XBOX Series X|S and will be available day one with XBOX Game Pass on 15 September!

---- 
Play Early Access on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1374490

RuneScape: Dragonwilds will be available September 15, 2026 on PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC, alongside our 1.0 release. 

Wishlist Now: https://dragonwilds.runescape.com

Follow our Socials and Community Channels:
